Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to work with your lists. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorting, and grouping every time you open a project, you can now save your exact setup and return to it with one click. Track sprint progress, flag overdue tasks, or organize work by priority — then save that view for instant access later.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, plenty of room to organize different projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters from scratch. Shared views keep reporting consistent and make it easier for new teammates to get up to speed quickly.

Give Saved Views a try and see how much time it saves your team this week.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
